name: Mace Infusion
description: Block an elemental attack, infusing your weapon with that element.
effects:
When you cast this skill, there is a brief animation in which you can block any kind of attack. If the blocked attack deals any elemental (non- physical) damage, you gain a Boon and an Imbue of that element on your Mace. If you have a dagger in your off-hand while casting, you also gain the same Imbue on it. In the case of multiple elements on one attack, the priority is first by which element dealt the most damage, but in the case of equal damage, the priority is then > > > > . The Imbue and Boon that you receive depend on the first element in the priority order that you blocked: Fire: Frost: Lightning: Decay: Ethereal:

Boons and imbues gained by blocked element:
• Fire attack → Warm boon (+20% Fire damage/resistance) + Fire imbue
• Frost attack → Cool boon (+20% Frost damage/resistance) + Frost imbue
• Lightning attack → Blessed boon (+20% Lightning damage/resistance) + Lightning imbue
• Ethereal attack → Mist boon (+20% Ethereal damage/resistance) + Ethereal imbue
• Decay attack → Possessed boon (+20% Decay damage/resistance) + Decay imbue
Imbue effects use the Mystic-level values (see Infuse Fire / Infuse Frost). Boon values are amplified by Shamanic Resonance.
unlock_requirement: Learned from Trainer or Quest reward
